name: New direct-family recall supplement v1
candidate_source: HDJoJo V2/369397665 public0.40, YOLO26x+YOLOv8x as one family
mechanism: Add only new direct-family detections omitted by the original V18 existence vote. Preserve current0.41 geometry. Use the same equal-family boundary consensus for qualifying new detections.

candidate_checks.support_matching: Mutual best correspondence between each other source and the direct detections; missing source image supplies zero support
candidate_checks.correlated_unet_sources: Three source masks average within one family, never three votes
candidate_checks.boundary: Equal-family pixel majority with ties preserving direct candidate pixels
candidate_checks.after_overlap_removal: At least90% pixels retained, at least3 distinct original support families still match at IoU>=0.6
candidate_checks.expansion_conflicts: Reject every conflicting supplement instead of resolving by order

if_zero_qualifying_candidates: Do not submit and do not lower gates
limitation: Agreement audit of unlabeled public test predictions, not independent validation or proof of true positives. Previous sparse complement scored no displayed gain. Underlying models retain author credits in README; full model weight reconstruction is incomplete.
